fonttweaks.title: FontTweaks 0.12.1 - Text Display
fonttweaks.help: Fonts / Exclusions controls bundled fonts and character selection.
fonttweaks.pixel_help: GUI scale 3 baseline, 1–4px. New installs default to 1px. No reload when GUI size changes.
fonttweaks.blacklist_help: Blacklist excludes font replacement only. Unifont pixel processing still applies. Open the list to add or delete individual characters.
fonttweaks.pack_font_auto: Font: Auto (English grid match selects Misaki)
fonttweaks.blacklist_list_help: Add characters here. Each codepoint gets its own row.
fonttweaks.preview_spacing_hint: Open Preview to check actual multiline text.
fonttweaks.ui.title: FontTweaks 0.12.1 - Text Settings
fonttweaks.ui.compact_hint: Select a row to edit its details
fonttweaks.ui.desc.global: Basic text scale for menus and the in-game HUD.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.screen: Scale for menu, inventory and other screen text.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.hud: Scale for the in-game HUD text.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.button: Button labels only; button click targets are unchanged.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.chat: Scale for chat text, background and hit targets.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.global_line: Shared spacing multiplier for multiline text.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.pixel_toggle: Enable Unifont dot processing globally. Configure the pixel size and existing font separately for each GUI scale.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.pixel_count: At GUI 3, process Unifont to 1–4 screen pixels per dot.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.font_enable: Enable or disable bundled font replacement without reloading.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.font_choice: Choose your font. Auto uses Misaki at GUI scales 1–2 and the default font at GUI 3+.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.font_english: Whether to replace English and other Latin glyphs.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.blacklist: Excluded glyphs use their original fonts. Use the YACL list controls to add, edit, reorder or delete characters.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.letter_spacing: Change the horizontal space between glyphs. Zero is normal; positive widens; negative tightens. This is independent of line spacing. Text measurements, centering and wrapping follow the setting.
fonttweaks.gui_scale_font: Switch to Misaki on small GUI scale
fonttweaks.ui.desc.gui_scale_font: When ON with pixel processing, use configured glyphs at GUI3+ and Misaki at GUI2 or below. No reload on GUI changes; exclusions are preserved.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.pixel_auto: Choose Auto or 1–4 px. GUI 2 and GUI 4 with 1 px use native glyphs; GUI 3 at 2 px uses the existing pixel algorithm.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.english_exclusion: Keep English glyph tracking unchanged. English-only lines retain standard vertical spacing; lines with Japanese text use your configured line spacing.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.existing_font: Use a bundled font at this GUI scale: 3px selects Misaki Gothic 2, other sizes select PixelMplus12. OFF retains vanilla glyphs.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.profile_dots: Set dot size independently for each GUI scale (Auto or 1–4px). Start with a preset and switch to Custom for fine adjustments.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.presets: Apply settings to GUI1, GUI2, GUI3 and GUI4+. Preset 1 applies 1px correction only at GUI1 and GUI3. All presets disable English glyph replacement; use Custom for individual edits.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.profile.unifont_proce: Switch Unifont pixel processing on or off for this GUI scale only. Does not change the source textures of Misaki or PixelMplus.
fonttweaks.ui.desc.profile.replace_engli: Enable or disable Latin glyph and number font replacement at this GUI scale. All three presets use OFF.
